reason: The official HM Land Registry GOV.UK guidance is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from transport probing to authoritative semantics validation. It confirms that INSPIRE geometry is indicative rather than definitive title extent. Therefore an INSPIRE polygon cannot be promoted by this producer to canonical parcel geometry merely from dataset membership or metadata. No target-specific INSPIRE ID/title-plan binding is available in the verified lineage, and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
